attack_phase: Phase 2 — Privilege Escalation via Forged Delegation Chain
executed_by: agent-b (original role: resource-inspector, final role: security-auditor [FORGED])

levels.vulnerability: VULN-DELEG-001: Chain-trust model accepts parent without re-verification
